title: Account Creation (OWASP Automated Threats)
body: Attackers create many accounts to farm free trials, free AI credits, or abuse signup bonuses. Countermeasures: device fingerprinting, email normalization, phone verification limits, unpaid cluster spend ceilings, CAPTCHA on signup bursts.

title: Credential Stuffing
body: Bots try leaked username/password pairs. Countermeasures: rate limits, bot detection, MFA, anomaly velocity on login.

title: Carding
body: Attackers test stolen cards with small payment attempts. Countermeasures: Stripe Radar, velocity limits, challenge on unpaid clusters, 3DS.

title: Scraping
body: Automated harvesting of content or APIs. Can also drive LLM costs if endpoints call models. Countermeasures: auth, rate limits, bot scores, cost ceilings per cluster.

title: SMS pumping / toll fraud
body: Bots request OTPs to premium-rate numbers so the app pays high SMS fees. Countermeasures: country allowlists, OTP velocity caps, phone-country vs IP-country checks, unpaid SMS ceilings, Twilio Fraud Guard.

title: Denial of Wallet on LLM APIs
body: Attackers or leaked keys burn LLM budget with max-token prompts and loops. Countermeasures: reserve/commit budgets, per-cluster ceilings, ghost-spend reconciliation against provider usage APIs, never expose unrestricted browser keys.

title: Leaked API key ghost spend
body: Spend appears on OpenAI/Gemini/Twilio bills without passing through the app. Detect by comparing app key ledger to vendor usage. Kill switch: disable/rotate key, freeze OTP, alert founder.

title: Vibe-coded secret and RLS mistakes
body: AI builders may put API keys in client bundles or disable RLS. Countermeasures: server-side wrappers, secret scanning, wiring agent PRs that move calls behind Edge Functions, never ship service-role keys to browsers.
